thread_title: Any good SIM-only plan recommendations?
post_text: I will throw out a potentially unpopular recommendation… SingTel priority sim-only plan (no contract) I’ve rotated through SIM-only plans from various MVNOs and full carriers (SIMBA/MyRepublic/Gomo/Giga/Eight; StarHub & SingTel sim-only), and SingTel remains the most reliable by a fair margin. I still do get dropped connections when on underground trains, but it’s a lot faster to get me back online than on other carriers, and in crowded places I don’t notice any throttling. For your use case where you’re constantly moving around and you need reliability for work, I’d go for it. Some do recommend Gomo since it’s owned by SingTel and uses its network, but my experience with their service (and their connectivity) is nowhere close to the full carrier.
